statement: BlueZ derives UHID phys and uniq from actual host-side and peer-side Bluetooth socket endpoints, and populates name, vendor, product and version via UHID_CREATE2. This is a host-side presentation convention, not a requirement that a local synthetic UHID contain a real controller's address. BlueZ shared hog.c lines 803-853 and uhid.c lines 391-435.

applicability.revision: host sources Linux v7.3, SDL e0232c5 and 531acc, BlueZ aa4f5ce; device firmware not measured
applicability.scope: Consumer source evidence, not physical Bluetooth or virtual-host observation. Host-visible synthetic identity policy must be decided separately from the feature-report unit serial.
